# Python Flask Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Python

## Overview

Builds web applications and APIs with Flask including blueprints, extensions, template rendering, and application factory patterns

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [python-flask-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
python-flask-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@python-flask-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build Flask applications with factory pattern
- Organize routes with Blueprint modules
- Configure SQLAlchemy and Flask-Migrate
- Implement authentication with Flask-Login

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Flask Best Practices**: Official Flask patterns and conventions
- **Application Factory**: Factory pattern for Flask configuration
- **Flask Extensions**: Extension integration guidelines
